api_key.label: Last.fm API Key
api_key.description: Optional. Override the built-in API key.

username.label: Last.fm Username
username.description: Your Last.fm username for genre-based recommendations (optional)

enable_personalized.label: Enable Personalized Recommendations
enable_personalized.description: Provide 'Similar Artists' and 'Similar Tracks' rows based on your listening history

enable_global_charts.label: Enable Global Charts
enable_global_charts.description: Provide 'Global Top Artists' and 'Global Top Tracks' rows from Last.fm's worldwide charts

enable_genre.label: Enable Genre Recommendations
enable_genre.description: Provide 'Top Artists', 'Top Albums' and 'Top Tracks' rows for your most played genre (requires username)

enable_geo.label: Enable Geographic Charts
enable_geo.description: Provide 'Top Artists' and 'Top Tracks' rows for the selected country

geo_country.label: Country for Geographic Charts
geo_country.description: Select country for geography-based top artists and tracks

clear_cache.label: Refresh Recommendations
clear_cache.description: Rebuild recommendations immediately instead of waiting for the next scheduled refresh.

statsfm_username.label: stats.fm Profile
statsfm_username.description: Optional username or profile URL. Use your public stats.fm rankings for Your Top Artists and personalized discovery instead of Music Assistant recent plays. Enable Personalized Recommendations to show these rows.

statsfm_period.label: stats.fm Listening Period
statsfm_period.description: Time period for your top artists and the top 5 artist / top 20 track discovery seeds. Uses your stats.fm sorting preference.

genre_artists.subtitle: Top artists in your top genres
